classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Find and analyze representative sequences for NAD(P)HX repair proteins with ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase and NADPHX epimerase activity, then rank representative sequence candidates by biochemical quality metrics derived from sequence-level analysis.
assumptions: GO:0034444 is the canonical molecular-function term for ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity and directly targets the dehydratase component of the NAD(P)HX repair system.
GO:0034445 is the canonical molecular-function term for NAD(P)HX epimerase activity and captures the epimerase component of the same repair pathway.

IPR004443 (YjeF_N N-terminal domain) covers the broader NAD(P)HX repair superfamily including dehydratase-lineage members that may not yet carry explicit GO molecular-function annotations, providing complementary domain-level coverage.
Swiss-Prot reviewed-only sequences are used for all three retrieval nodes to maximise annotation quality; TrEMBL entries can be included by setting reviewed to null if coverage is insufficient.
IEA (inferred from electronic annotation) evidence codes are excluded from GO pulls so that only experimentally or curator-assigned function annotations are retained.
Sequence fragments are excluded from the InterPro pull to prevent partial-length outliers from skewing downstream ranking.
pH 7.4 is used for charge and liability calculations in sequence_analysis, reflecting typical intracellular conditions where the NAD(P)HX repair enzymes operate.
Top 10 representative candidates are returned by rank_designs; top_k can be raised without changing any other node.
No structural prediction, inverse-folding, or docking steps are required for this sequence-characterisation and triage task.
rank_designs receives the full analysis output objects from all three upstream sequence_analysis nodes as its analyses list and produces a deterministically ranked table.

success_criteria.ranked_table: Deterministically ranked top-10 NAD(P)HX repair protein sequences with aggregated biochemical quality scores from sequence_analysis
success_criteria.activity_coverage: Candidate set spans both enzymatic activities (GO:0034444 dehydratase, GO:0034445 epimerase) and the YJEF_N domain family (IPR004443)
success_criteria.per_candidate_annotations: Composition, net charge at pH 7.4, motif and region annotations, and sequence liabilities for every ranked candidate
